name: Macro Deck Surface
description: Turn the panel into a Macro Deck surface: renders a Macro Deck host's live button page and sends taps, long-presses and releases back over its client WebSocket.

preview.note: This preview connects to the Macro Deck host as a separate device (not your panel), so it won’t disturb it. Click Connect inside the preview, and accept the device on the host the first time; its page may differ from the panel, and taps are disabled here.

options.label: Macro Deck host
options.help: Address of the Macro Deck host, e.g. 127.0.0.1:8191 or 192.168.1.50:8191. Macro Deck must be running; the first time you connect, accept this device on the host.

options.label: Device name
options.help: Name this surface shows as on the Macro Deck host when you accept it.

options.label: Key shape
options.help: Square keys match the Macro Deck host and are recommended. Wide changes key shape to fill the panel width; artwork is not stretched.

options.label: Long-press delay (ms)
options.help: How long a key must be held before a long-press action is sent (100–10000).
